context: Evaluates correct use of the output_path auto-save feature in spprof's start() function. Checks that the candidate passes output_path to start() (not to save() separately), that the directory is created automatically, and that the file exists after stop() completes.

checklist.name: output_path passed to start()
checklist.description: output_path='profiles/run1/result.json' is passed to spprof.start() (not called separately on the profile object)

checklist.name: File exists after stop()
checklist.description: After spprof.stop() is called, profiles/run1/result.json exists on disk

checklist.name: Existence check and print
checklist.description: The script checks whether the file exists and prints 'Saved' or 'Missing' accordingly

checklist.name: Directory auto-creation
checklist.description: The profiles/run1/ directory is not manually pre-created; it is handled by the profiler
